channel.title: Flog It!
channel.desc: Paul Martin and antiques experts Michael Baggott and Kate Bateman visit Dulwich College in London. Michael falls in love with a Chinese censor, Kate is enamoured by a charming collection of bronze animals and Paul makes the short journey to Dulwich Picture Gallery, where he is privileged to see one of the best collections of European old masters in the world.
